name: Piano Tiles
description: Piano Tiles for the pads: tiles fall in four lanes, the pads show what comes, each tile plays the next note of a public-domain tune on a small piano synth; levels speed it up, best scores saved on the card; the one app of the pianotiles firmware kit
changelog: 0.1.1: Pausing while the song's last long note is held now ends the song as cleared (score, best and unlocks kept) instead of leaving an empty field after Resume

0.1.0: Piano Tiles as a CrossPad app: six songs, five levels each, hold tiles, the pads mirror the field, a piano-like synth on the audio module, progress in crosspad/pianotiles/ on the card, pause menu with Quit back to the other firmware slot
